evidence.title: Amazon overhauls aging devices lineup with higher-priced Alexa tablet, dumping the budget Fire

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Fire tablet support policy and manufacturing records
occurrences.quote_span: Amazon said it will continue to support the Fire lineup for four years after the final shipment and consumers can continue using their devices as they do today, but it is no longer manufacturing new units.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon statement on Alexa tablet pricing and memory costs
occurrences.quote_span: Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet operating-system specifications
occurrences.quote_span: One of the most notable upgrades is that all of the devices run Google's Android operating system, a major departure from earlier models, which relied on a custom Android version dubbed Fire OS and used Amazon's own app store, limiting the number of apps that were available.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa Tablet 12 Pro and Fire HD 10 product prices
occurrences.quote_span: The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet product pages and preorder/shipping records
occurrences.quote_span: The company unveiled 8-inch, 11-inch and 12-inch models, which start at $230 and run up to $550. All devices are available for preorder on Thursday and will begin shipping Oct. 14.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet specifications and product announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The company said the Alexa tablet's improved speed and performance, artificial intelligence features, and upgraded design warrant a higher price tag and put the devices on par with "the best tablets on the market."
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: CNBC interview recording or transcript with Panos Panay
occurrences.quote_span: "I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview.
occurrences.speaker: Panos Panay
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa product history and Echo launch records
occurrences.quote_span: It's also the first time Amazon has attached a set of devices to the Alexa brand, the company's automated assistant first launched in 2014 via the Echo smart speaker.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet feature documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: CNBC demonstration recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video.
occurrences.speaker: Panos Panay
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet software and user-interface documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Panos Panay interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs."
occurrences.speaker: Panos Panay
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa product history and Echo launch records
occurrences.quote_span: It's also the first time Amazon has attached a set of devices to the Alexa brand, the company's automated assistant first launched in 2014 via the Echo smart speaker.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Alexa tablet technical specifications
occurrences.quote_span: Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon Fire tablet product catalog
occurrences.quote_span: The Fire lineup includes a 10-inch and 8-inch model as well as two versions targeted for kids.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon product announcement and Fire tablet manufacturing records
occurrences.quote_span: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon
occurrences.subject: Amazon Alexa tablets and Fire tablet lineup
